subject: POC Kickoff & Hands-on Session — Finova / Redwood
messages:
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC Kickoff & Hands-on Session — Finova / Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency/cost numbers. We'd like to move forward with a short POC to validate prompt routing and run a couple of load tests against our key flows.

Goals for the POC:
- Validate prompt templates and routing rules for our multi-tenant QA -> Prod routing.
- Run a modest load profile (peak 200TPS, sustained 40TPS) to check autoscaling and latency SLAs.
- Confirm prefix caching behavior for our billing prompts.

Requested kickoff: a 60–90 minute hands-on session (intro + working session) to review prompts and run an initial load test. Can we get this scheduled in the next 2 weeks?

Attendees on our side likely: myself (product), Priya Singh (Eng manager), Alex Moreno (SRE). We can share example prompts and traffic profile ahead of time.

Thanks — looking for a couple of proposed times that work for your technical team.

Best,
Sam
Sam Walters
Director of Product
Finova

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Wed 2026-03-03 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-03-04 — 10:00–11:30
- Fri 2026-03-05 — 09:00–10:30

We generally plan for a 30–45 minute intro (stakeholders, goals, success criteria) followed by a 45–60 minute hands-on working session where the engineer walks the team through prompt review, routing config, and a lightweight load test. Rishi — please confirm the 3/3–3/5 window for availability.

I've attached a short POC agenda and checklist (POC-Agenda-Finova.pdf). If you can send sample prompts and a traffic CSV, Rishi can pre-load them into a staging env.

Chloe will own success criteria and follow-ups. Typical success criteria: automated routing applied to test traffic, peak latency < 250ms p95 on your sample flows, and documented runbook for scaling decisions. Happy to refine.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi all — Rishi here. 3/4 at 10:00 PT works for me. I'll plan the session like this:

Agenda (technical):
- 10:00–10:15 Intro + success criteria (Marissa/Chloe/Priya)
- 10:15–10:45 Prompt review + routing config (Rishi + Alex)
- 10:45–11:15 Hands-on load run (we'll run a single 15–20 minute ramp)
- 11:15–11:30 Next steps and handoff

Prep items for Finova (please upload to the shared link):
1) sample_prompts.txt — representative prompt templates and expected completions
2) load_test_template.csv — timestamps, user ids, qps profile (we use this to generate synthetic traffic)

I'm attaching the two templates we use: sample_prompts.txt and load_test_template.csv. For the load run, we plan a modest profile: 1) ramp to 40TPS sustained for 10 minutes, 2) a 2-minute spike to 200TPS to validate autoscaling and fallback. We'll coordinate with your SRE (Alex) to ensure IP allowlist and any rate-limits are accounted for.

Regarding compliance: if you're running any customer PII in the prompts we'll need a short SSO/KMS checklist signed; Chloe, can you advise.

-Rishi
